requisitions.displayJobTitle: Work Integrated Technical Learner - Plumber (Durban, Richards Bay, CPT, East London, PE, Saldanha)
requisitions.externalDescription: The Work Integrated Learning (WIL) Trainee Programme aims to provide recently qualified apprentices ( with a red seal) with practical work experience allowing them to apply their academic and vocational or practical knowledge in a real-world environment. This programme is designed to enhance participants' employability by offering hands-on training, mentorship, and exposure to industry-specific tasks. The WIL trainee programme is conducted over a period of 24 months.

Candidate to hold a Pilot License from any South African Port. A pilot’s primary duty is to use his skill and knowledge to protect the ship from collision, grounding and other hazard by providing accurate and timely navigational advice to the vessel master. Where so approved by the master, the pilot may be required to safely conduct the navigation and manoeuvring of the vessel whilst in pilotage waters The pilot is further responsible; • For the manoeuvring of the vessel within port limits having due regard for safety of the vessel, its crew and the environment. • Is also there to ensure the safe and efficient docking / undocking and shifting of vessels within port limit. • Must recognise that the observance of good seamanship dictates that operational contingency plans be available at all times • Provide the master with an efficient service by sharing with them his professional ship handling ship skills and his local knowledge.
